title: Cocycle-valid stage for the relative datum
statement:
Fix a raw relative gluing datum $R$ of [def-nagata-relative-gluing-datum-descent], with its fixed binary upper bounds and auxiliary linear order of [def-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound]. Use the canonical raw chart and overlap schemes over the raw base. Fix their canonical inclusion maps, characterized by their projections to the descended charts and by their over-base typing. Write $a_{jkl}$ and $b_{jkl}$ for the left and right inclusions and $g_{jkl}$ and $h_{jkl}$ for the forward and backward maps followed by the corresponding chart inclusions. Write $W_{jk}$ and $V_{jk}$ for the unions of the left and right raw overlap opens.
Form the following finite lists. The open equations are $W_{jj}=T_j$, $W_{jk}=V_{kj}$, and $g_{jkl}^{-1}(W_{kz})=a_{jkl}^{-1}(W_{jz})$ for every chart triple and first overlap piece. The map equations are the two inverse identities on each piece, agreement of forward maps on intersections of left pieces, agreement of backward maps on intersections of right pieces, agreement of forward maps with backward maps of the reversed orientation on their common domain, the identity $g_{jjl}=a_{jjl}$, and the triple cocycle $g_{kzm} g_{jkl}=g_{jzn}$ on the fibre product expressing the common domain of these composites and the direct piece. All common domains are canonical fibre products over the charts in the category of schemes over the raw base.
For each listed open equation retain the compactness and limit-equality inputs of [def-nagata-qc-open-equality-stage] and apply that construction. For each listed parallel map equation retain the finite-presentation, affine-cover, generator and coefficient-equality choices of [def-nagata-morphism-equality-stage] and apply that construction; the finite coefficient witnesses are supplied by [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data]. Define $\lambda_{\mathrm{rel}}$ to be the selected finite upper bound of the raw stage and exactly these selected equality stages. Define $\mathsf R_{X,\lambda_{\mathrm{rel}}}$ by canonical base change of all raw charts, overlap schemes, inclusions and both overlap-map directions, with inverse images of their raw opens. Functorial base change identifies the sources and targets of parallel maps and preserves their equations. The actual gluing axioms at this stage are the subsequent eventual-axioms lemma, not inputs to this definition.

statement_change.old_statement:
For the raw datum, form the finite list of required equalities of overlap
opens, inverse identities, and triple-overlap cocycles. Attach to each the
selected equality stage from the preceding constructions and define
$\lambda_{\mathrm{rel}}(X/S)$ to be their common upper bound together with
$\lambda_{\mathrm{raw}}(X/S)$. Let
$\mathsf R_{X,\lambda_{\mathrm{rel}}}$ be the raw datum transported to this
stage.
Canonical comparison maps identify the source and target of each later-stage
equality. Transporting its witness preserves the equation, so the finite
upper-bound list is well typed.
statement_change.what: The finite list and the source/target identifications were unnamed. On basic overlap pieces a triple composite is not defined on the whole first piece, and separately descended pieces need not agree before further descent. Specify the common pullback domains, piecewise agreement, opposite orientations and diagonal conditions needed to glue; retain the preceding equality constructions as actual choice data.
